Class CounterWeightGarageDoorAnimationComponent

java.lang.Object
nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.core.structures.types.garagedoor.CounterWeightGarageDoorAnimationComponent
All Implemented Interfaces:
IAnimationComponent
Direct Known Subclasses:
SectionalGarageDoorAnimationComponent
public class CounterWeightGarageDoorAnimationComponent extends Object implements IAnimationComponent
Represents an IAnimationComponent for GarageDoor structure types.

This component moves the garage door as if it has a counterweight.
